parrafo.es: Green Oasis Landscaping & Design atiende Port St. Lucie con mantenimiento de cesped, diseno de jardines y cuidado de arboles y arbustos. Un equipo que trata cada propiedad como si fuera la propia, visita tras visita.
parrafo.en: Green Oasis Landscaping & Design serves Port St. Lucie with lawn maintenance, landscape design and tree and shrub care. A crew that treats every property like its own, visit after visit.

hero.imagen_alt: Freshly edged mulch bed with mature palms beside a screened lanai

parrafo_1.es: Green Oasis Landscaping & Design es una empresa de jardineria y paisajismo que atiende Port St. Lucie y alrededores. Mantenimiento de cesped, canteros limpios con bordes definidos y cuidado de palmeras, arboles y arbustos, propiedad por propiedad.
parrafo_1.en: Green Oasis Landscaping & Design is a landscaping and lawn care company serving Port St. Lucie and the surrounding area. Lawn maintenance, clean beds with defined edges, and care for palms, trees and shrubs, one property at a time.

parrafo_2.es: En Google, los clientes repiten lo mismo: James y su equipo hacen un trabajo prolijo, puntual y honesto, y muchos llevan mas de un ano trabajando juntos sin una sola queja.
parrafo_2.en: On Google, clients say the same thing over and over: James and his crew do neat, prompt, honest work, and many have worked together for over a year without a single complaint.

nosotros.imagen_1_alt: Lush entrance planting bed with bromeliads, crotons and palms
nosotros.imagen_2_alt: Rounded flowering shrub kept neat along a fence line

texto.es: Nos cuentas que necesita tu jardin desde nuestra ficha de Google Maps. Te respondemos para coordinar una visita y darte un precio real.
texto.en: Tell us what your yard needs through our Google Maps listing. We get back to you to set up a visit and give you a real price.

texto.es: Recorremos la propiedad, revisamos cesped, canteros y arboles, y te explicamos que hace falta antes de empezar.
texto.en: We walk the property, check the lawn, beds and trees, and explain what is needed before we start any work.

texto.es: El equipo corta, borda, poda y limpia con el mismo cuidado que vemos en las resenas de nuestros clientes.
texto.en: The crew mows, edges, trims and cleans up with the same care our clients describe in their reviews.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado contigo y, si quieres, armamos un plan de mantenimiento regular para que el jardin se mantenga asi.
texto.en: We review the result with you and, if you want, set up a regular maintenance plan so the yard stays looking this way.

nota.es: Cada propiedad es distinta. Escribenos por Google Maps y te damos un precio real tras una visita rapida.
nota.en: Every property is different. Message us through Google Maps and we will give you a real price after a quick look.

texto.es: Corte, borde y limpieza regular para que el cesped se mantenga parejo y prolijo todo el ano.
texto.en: Regular mowing, edging and clean up so the lawn stays even and tidy all year.

texto.es: Canteros nuevos, mulch, bordes y plantas tropicales pensadas para el clima de Port St. Lucie.
texto.en: New beds, mulch, edging and tropical plantings suited to the Port St. Lucie climate.

texto.es: Poda de palmeras, arbustos y arboles pequenos para mantener la propiedad en orden y segura.
texto.en: Trimming palms, shrubs and small trees to keep the property neat and safe.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Escribenos igual: adaptamos el servicio a tu jardin.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Message us anyway: we adapt the service to your yard.

items.quote: Best lawn maintenance company I've dealt with by far. The owner James and his staff provide great quality service at a fair price. Glad I was referred to him by my co-worker. I would definitely recommend this company 100%.

James and his crew have worked for me over a year now and I have been extremely happy with the way they have kept my property!! I've never been disappointed, not once! I'll add that I'm a little particular about the appearance of my ...

I have always had great service from James. He has always done a quality job and efficient prompt service. He has always been an honest hard worker and a great guy to do business with. I always had quality work done and look forward to doing business with him in years to come.
